text:
From having all appointments on schedule without missing or rescheduling,
the doctor was always on time. Before getting braces, my lower teeth protruded, while my upper teeth were straight and aligned.
After two years of treatment, my lower teeth started to separate, and one upper tooth became noticeably crooked, though not severely.
The doctor said something like, "You can adjust the rubber bands yourself; stop when you're satisfied." After the treatment was finished, I had an X-ray done elsewhere, and my teeth were misshapen. My lower teeth, which were protruding, were now noticeably crooked, and my upper teeth were visibly protruding. The main issue is that my lower teeth are noticeably crooked, and the gaps between my upper teeth are very prominent. My upper teeth are slightly overlapping, especially the two front teeth. Is this what a doctor means by "finished treatment"? Anyone considering braces, please do your research thoroughly.
P.S. The doctor broke a brace while scaling and blamed me, saying I dropped it.
P.S. The orthodontist said, "Adjust the rubber bands yourself; stop when you're satisfied."
P.S. There were mice running around in the clinic.
P.S. The doctor didn't change their gloves often.
Now, I've had my braces off for a month and am about to get treatment at a new clinic. I curse the old clinic; everything was terrible. I didn't mind wasting my money. But the results were too bad.

restaurant_name: Kelly dental clinic ทันตกรรมเคลลี่เมเจอร์รังสิต
text:
I'd like to suggest improving the level of attentiveness towards patients. During adjustments or consultations, I'd like the doctor to provide more concise and detailed advice. When I went for adjustments, the doctor wasn't very helpful. I'd like a clearer explanation of what I need to do this month and next month. During the adjustment, everything was fine. Then, at the counter, the staff told me what I needed to do this month. I was confused because the doctor didn't explain anything.
I was told again when paying, before I even had a chance to hear it from the doctor. I felt very disappointed that they didn't communicate more with the patient, providing details about my teeth and the treatment plan for the month. For example, mentioning changes to the wires and a little pain during adjustment would be helpful. It's about the patient's peace of mind. I chose this clinic because I want good service for the money I'm spending, as we'll be together for a long time. I want more attentiveness from both the doctor and staff. It will benefit the branch, both customers and everyone involved. 🙏
P.S. Overall, I'm impressed with the location; it's easy to get to, and the prices aren't too high, making it suitable for students or anyone looking for good promotions.
However, the selection of rubber bands is a bit limited, and the scan-to-pay feature isn't a quick fix.
